gui.dmzdivine.ritual.title: Super Saiyan God Ritual
gui.dmzdivine.ritual.instructions: Press SPACE when the cursor is inside the divine zone!
gui.dmzdivine.ritual.win: The divine ki flows through you!
gui.dmzdivine.ritual.lose: The ki dispersed... the ritual failed.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.already: You have already awakened the divine ki.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.wrong_race: Your body cannot channel divine ki.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.form_level: You are not strong enough yet for the ritual (requires %s level %s).
message.dmzdivine.ritual.alignment: The divine ki demands a righteous heart.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.tp: You need %s Training Points to attempt the ritual.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.failed: The ritual failed. Focus your mind and try again.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.misconfigured: The ritual cannot be performed: the server is missing the god form configuration. Ask an admin to check the server log.
message.dmzdivine.ritual.success: The ki of five righteous Saiyans flows into you... Super Saiyan God unlocked!
gui.dmzdivine.uitrial.title: Whis' Trial - Ultra Instinct
gui.dmzdivine.uitrial.instructions: Dodge with WASD only in the last instant - reacting early is reading, not feeling.
gui.dmzdivine.uitrial.win: Your body moved on its own!
gui.dmzdivine.uitrial.lose: You thought about it. That is why it hit you.
message.dmzdivine.beerus.arrival: You set foot on the God of Destruction's planet. The gravity here is not made for mortals.
message.dmzdivine.arena.entered: Whis' arena: %sg. Training Points earned here are multiplied by %s.
message.dmzdivine.arena.left: You step out of the arena. The weight lifts.
gui.dmzdivine.whis.title: Whis
gui.dmzdivine.whis.weights_prompt: How heavy? Anything you cannot carry teaches nothing.
gui.dmzdivine.whis.status_ready: You are ready for trial %s. Shall we?
gui.dmzdivine.whis.status_mastered: There is nothing left for me to teach you about this.
message.dmzdivine.whis.weights_given: Weight bells of %s. Wear them, do not fight them.
message.dmzdivine.goku.seek_beerus: The god ki isn't mine to hand out. Beerus is the one who decides - and he lives a long way from here.
message.dmzdivine.whis.keep_training: You have trained %s of the %s minutes I asked for. Feel the gravity, do not fight it.
message.dmzdivine.whis.no_tp: Mastering this costs %s Training Points. Come back when you have them.
message.dmzdivine.whis.trial_start: Then let us see. I will strike - do not think, move.
message.dmzdivine.whis.trial_start_maste: Sign was the easy half. This time I will not hold back.
message.dmzdivine.whis.trial_failed: You reacted with your mind. Train more.
message.dmzdivine.whis.trial_won_sign: Your body moved on its own... Ultra Instinct Sign unlocked!
message.dmzdivine.whis.trial_won_mastere: Silver eyes, calm mind. Mastered Ultra Instinct unlocked!
message.dmzdivine.whis.mastered: There is nothing left for me to teach you about this.
message.dmzdivine.whis.misconfigured: The trial cannot be granted: the server is missing the Ultra Instinct configuration. Ask an admin to check the server log.
gui.dragonminez.minigame.meditation.desc: Sit inside Whis' arena, in Ultra Instinct, and let the weight do the work. Training Points come in every second while you stay still and your ki holds out - no reflexes, no score, just the discipline of not moving. Any hit that lands breaks it.
gui.dmzdivine.meditation.title: Meditation
gui.dmzdivine.meditation.hint: Stay here. Closing this ends the meditation.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.started: You settle into the gravity and close your eyes. Do not move.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.moved: You moved. The thread of concentration is gone.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.left_arena: Outside the arena there is no weight to meditate against.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.form_lost: Ultra Instinct faded, and the meditation with it.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.exhausted: You have nothing left to feed the meditation.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.need_arena: Only Whis' arena is heavy enough for this.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.need_ui: Meditate like this only in Ultra Instinct - the body has to be the one listening.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.not_taught: You do not know how to meditate like that yet. Whis does.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.taught: Sitting still is harder than fighting, and worth more. Now you know how.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.reminder: You already know this one. Sit, and let the body listen.
message.dmzdivine.meditation.how: Inside the arena, in Ultra Instinct, press the meditation key (M by default).
